jaxR: composable transformations of array programs in R

Source: R/jaxR-package.R
jaxR-package.Rd

An R mirror of the JAX Python package. Programs written with jnp_*, lax_* and the usual R operators are traced to jaxprs, transformed (grad(), vmap(), jvp(), vjp()) and compiled by XLA through the PJRT C API (jit()). Run install_pjrt() once to install the XLA runtime.
